architectReview.evidence: Leader doc-accuracy review of the README refresh (G001). README.md was stale: it claimed 'cargo test - 3 pass' (now 11), '8 MCP tools' (now 7), and documented none of the shipped local flow. The refresh: (a) adds a 'Local test flow' section documenting project init/show, test add/list, test generate, and test run [--json --fix] including the LLM code-gen, verdict/cause failure analysis, and the fixes/<id>.md repair-patch output; (b) corrects the module-map tools row to '7 MCP tool handlers'; (c) adds a local/* module-map row; (d) fixes the Status test count to 11 and folds the local flow into the verified-live list. Every claim was checked against the code (mcp.rs tool count, the actual clap `test` subcommands) and a clean build. Doc-only change; no code touched.
